content: JSON Resume schema v1.x: sections basics (name,label,email,url,summary,location{city,countryCode,region},profiles[]), work (name,position,url,startDate,endDate,summary,highlights[],keywords[]), education (institution,area,studyType,startDate,endDate,courses[]), skills (name,level,keywords[]), languages (language,fluency), projects (name,summary,highlights[],keywords[],startDate,endDate,url,roles[],entity,type), meta (canonical,version,lastModified). No localization support; convention is one resume.json per language if needed. Official hosting is via GitHub Gist registry; serving /resume.json from your own domain is a self-hosting convention, not an official path. Validate with resume-cli or resumed.
